paite: "Ka lungsim hihgawp in a-om a, ka nite abei a, kei a ding in han mansa in a-om hi.
english: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

paite: Ka kiang ah musit mite a-om taktak ua, ahehna uah ka mit a-om gige hi.
english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

paite: Tu in thuchiam hon pia in, nangmah toh kei a ding in moh khu hong hi in; kei toh khutte beng ding kua a-om a?
english: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

paite: Theihsiamna a kipan alungtang uh na sel ngal a; huaiziak in amau na hihlian kei ding hi.
english: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

paite: "Kuapeuh mat ding a alawmte hek a, aneih-le-lam tan tummi, atate nangawn mit azuausuak ding hi.
english: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

paite: Mite houlimna ding in ahon bawl lai a; huchi in tangpi kih ka hong hita hi.
english: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

paite: Lungkhamna ziak in ka mit leng amial a, ka hiangte tengteng limliap bang ahi.
english: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

paite: Midikte'n hiai ah lamdang asa ding ua, mihoih Pathian limsakloute dou ding in akitokthou ding.
english: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

paite: Himahleh midiktat alampi ah apang zouzou dia, kuapeuh khut siangneite ahat semsem ding uhi.
english: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

paite: Himahleh hong kik un, na vek un, tu in hong un; huchi in na lak uah mipil ka mu kei ding.
english: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

paite: "Ka nite abeita, ka thiltupte asegawpta hi, ka lungtang ngaihtuahte tan in.
english: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

paite: Zan, sun in akheng ua; khovak in khomial anaih, achi uh.
english: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

paite: Ka inn bang in Sheol en leng: khomial ah ka lupna phah taleng:
english: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

paite: siatna kiang ah, 'Ka pa na hi,' chi leng; tangtel kiang ah, 'Ka nu leh ka sanggamnu na hi,' chi leng;
english: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

paite: huchi hileh ka lametna koi a om ahia? Lamet nei hi leng kua'n ahon musak dia?
english: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

paite: Sheol mundaite ah paisuk in leivui ah ka kikkhawm ding ua adiam?"
english: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”
